title: Handoff
summary: Writes a full handoff for a fresh session, and suggests one after 2 compactions or at 80% context.
details: When you say write a handoff, Claude writes the job, every decision, your own words and answers word for word, the status and the next steps to ~/.claude/handoffs, and can pass it to another session if you give its id. A hook also suggests a handoff after 2 compactions or at 80 percent context. It is for jobs too big for one session. It adds a skill loaded only when used, a Stop hook that checks context after each answer, a rule file and settings entries; local files only, no network.
trigger: Say "write a handoff" (add a session id to pass it on). A hook also suggests one when context gets big.
risk: A Stop hook checks context size after each answer; the skill writes files under ~/.claude/handoffs. No network.
